definitions.gloss: full run-through rehearsal; performing a piece or show from beginning to end without stopping
definitions.explanation: full run-through rehearsal; performing a piece or show from beginning to end without stopping

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通|とお}し{稽古|げいこ}だ。
examples.english: Tomorrow is the full run-through rehearsal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通|とお}し{稽古|げいこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We did a full run-through before the actual performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧{通|とお}し{稽古|げいこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}{像|ぞう}→全体像：16443_zentaizou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧きた。
examples.english: During the dress run-through, the full picture of the production became clear for the first time.

notes:
A rehearsal where a performance is practiced from start to finish without interruption, as opposed to working on individual scenes or sections. Used in theater, traditional performing arts (kabuki, noh), dance, and music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通|とお}し{稽古|げいこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to do a full run-through
- {通|とお}し{稽古|げいこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ — to begin the run-through phase
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{通|とお}し{稽古|げいこ} — final run-through rehearsal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {稽古|げいこ} — practice; rehearsal (general term)
- ⟦リハーサル→リハーサル：07559_rihaasaru⟧ — rehearsal (loanword, common in modern theater and music)
- {下稽古|したげいこ} — preliminary rehearsal; practice before the main rehearsal
- ゲネプロ — dress rehearsal (from German Generalprobe)
